_note: Base template for a tenant's integration/mapping.json. Copy into config/tenants/<id>/integration/ when onboarding a tenant. Declare processingSequences + defaultSequence EXPLICITLY so the demand sort is exposed in the config, not assumed. If omitted, the platform falls back to order.priority asc and logs a warning at load; the active sequence is also reported in every solve result.
_crossWOLinkingNote: Set to 'bomParentChild' only for tenants whose WorkOrderGroups carry BOM parent/child precedence (e.g. Stafford). Default 'none'.
